mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_team t ON t.id=u.team_id ORDER BY u.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_team t ON t.id=u.team_id WHERE u.id=#{id} AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT r.id AS id,r.name,r.code,r.status FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id=r.id WHERE ur.user_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.id
SELECT id,name,NULL AS code,status FROM sys_team ORDER BY id
SELECT id,name,code,status FROM sys_role WHERE status=1 ORDER BY id
SELECT id,name,NULL AS code,status FROM sys_team WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT id,name,code,status FROM sys_role WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE code='member' AND status=1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET real_name=#{realName},card_number=#{cardNumber},team_id=#{teamId}, phone=#{phone},avatar_url=#{avatarUrl},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_superuser=0
UPDATE sys_user SET status=#{status},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_superuser=0
UPDATE sys_user SET status=0,deleted_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_superuser=0

UPDATE sys_user SET password_hash=#{passwordHash},must_change_password=1, password_changed_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_superuser=0
UPDATE sys_user SET updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_superuser=0
